title: Incorrect package name in __getattr__
detail: The __getattr__ implementation returns the version of the 'werkzeug' package instead of 'jinja2', causing callers to receive the wrong version string.
note: Real: the merged PR looks up the version of `werkzeug`, not `jinja2`. Its maintainers fixed it two minutes after it merged.

title: shlex.split may raise ValueError
detail: If pager_cmd contains unmatched quotes or other syntax errors, shlex.split will raise ValueError, causing the function to crash. This is not caught or handled.
note: True that `shlex.split` raises on unmatched quotes in `PAGER`; whether click should handle a malformed `PAGER` is a judgement.
